name: CCO Developers Working Group
summary: Bring together ontology developers across organizations and projects with members of the Common Core Ontologies (CCO) Governance Board and Developers Group to recommend and implement changes to CCO to meet the evolving needs of the CCO community
participation:
Want to help shape the Common Core Ontologies? Email the working group’s point of contact for an invite to the meetings.

Have a change you’d like to see? Open an issue on GitHub so it can be tracked and discussed.
cadence: Weekly (Tuesday) at 2 p.m. Eastern Time Zone
provenance: Community-submitted listing. Participation and meeting details are reported by the submitter; directory review does not independently verify these claims.
